newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Far East sells more Singapore property.
newsitem.headline: Far East sells more Singapore property.

text.p: Hong Kong's Far East International Holdings Ltd said on Thursday it has agreed to sell some office units for Singapore $57 million to Malaysia's Kemayan Corp Bhd.
Earlier, the Far East group had agreed to sell its Singapore theme park, the Tang Dynasty City Pte Ltd, for HK$260 million.

A Far East statement said two of its Singapore subsidiaries have granted an option to Kemayan to buy all the office units with a combined area of 57,070.2 sq ft in Parkway Builders Centre in the eastern part of the island.
The option is exercisable after fulfilment of certain conditions.
Far East said the sale price works out to be about S$1,000 per sq ft.
The payment would be satisfied by the allotment of shares by Kemayan Corp, which is subject to the approval of the Securities Commission of Malaysia.
The proposed issue price is 2.30 Malaysian ringgit per share. Kemayan shares closed at 3.64 ringgit on Wednesday, down six sen.
Far East said the sale proceeds will be invested in other property and leisure related projects.
